period_note: Standalone (solo) basis. This filing prints the full statement sequence TWICE: Condensed CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet/P&L/Statement of Changes in Equity/Cash Flow (pp.2-6) followed by the bank's own Condensed [Solo] Balance Sheet/P&L/Statement of Changes in Equity/Cash Flow, captioned without the word 'Consolidated' (pp.7-11) — per project convention Solo is used here. Matches the basis of this bank's own 2012-2016 and 2021-2025 solo series. Consolidated total assets (369,683,021,854) vs Solo (325,288,312,568) differ by ~44,395m (~13.6%), almost entirely the bKash/subsidiary consolidation effect — the two bases are not interchangeable. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly: 325,288,312,568 = 292,386,872,398 (total liabilities) + 32,901,440,170 (total equity). P&L reconciles exactly to the taka at every subtotal: 5,475,921,491 (total operating income) minus 2,737,286,319 (opex) = 2,738,635,172 (profit before provisions), minus 637,914,792 (total provision) = 2,100,720,380 (profit before tax), minus 833,650,478 (tax) = 1,267,069,902 (net profit after tax). The solo P&L carries no 'share of profit of associates' line (that adjustment only appears in the consolidated P&L), so 'Profit before provisions (c=a-b)' doubles as operating profit and is recorded once under operating_profit, per this bank's established convention for solo statements lacking an associates adjustment (see 2016_Q1/2017_Q1/2020_Q2/2021_Q2). Small equity sub-reserves (dividend equalization fund 355,218,455; revaluation reserve on govt. securities 14,201,677; assets revaluation reserve 478,558,600; translation reserve -15,191,405) are not broken out as separate line items, consistent with this bank's recent-quarter practice — total_equity is the full reported total inclusive of them. Off-balance-sheet exposures, CRAR, ROE, ROA and AD ratio are all taken from the Solo-basis disclosures (p.8 off-balance-sheet total and NAV; p.13 'Key Financial Indicators (Standalone basis)' and 'Key Financial Ratios (Standalone basis)'); ROE/ROA are the source's own annualized figures. Source PDF is a scanned image with no text layer (pdftotext extracts 0 lines, hence the retained .txt is empty) — figures read visually from 150dpi page renders.
